settings.heading: Us vs. Them
settings.subtext: Most sleep aids either leave you groggy or create dependency. Zylla Sleep works with your body's natural systems.

settings.heading: What's Inside
settings.content: Each sachet contains 300mg Magnesium Glycinate, 200mg L-Theanine, 300mg KSM-66® Ashwagandha, and 50mg Lemon Balm Extract. No melatonin — because long-term melatonin supplementation can disrupt your natural hormone production.

settings.heading: How to Use
settings.content: Mix one sachet into 200ml of warm water 30–45 minutes before bed. Avoid screens after taking — let the ingredients work with your body's natural wind-down process.

settings.heading: The Science
settings.content: Our formula works with your body's existing sleep systems rather than overriding them. Magnesium Glycinate supports GABA (your brain's calming neurotransmitter). L-Theanine reduces alpha brain waves to promote relaxed alertness that transitions into sleep. KSM-66® Ashwagandha has 24 clinical trials proving its cortisol-reducing effects.
